insight: Founded in June 2023 by Jerry Meng, a Stanford computer-science dropout.
name: Kindroid
tagline: Deeply customizable AI companions with long-term memory, voice, and video calls.
description: Kindroid lets you build AI companions with custom appearance, personality, and backstory, backed by a long-term memory system and an auto-updating Shared Journal. Paid tiers add voice and video calls, AI selfies, and multiple companions; a free Lite tier offers unlimited basic chat.
edge: Memory-first companion: pin thousands of tokens of Key Memories plus an auto-updating Shared Journal the AI maintains.
pros: Deep customization of look, personality, backstory
Voice and video calls plus AI selfies
Free Lite tier with unlimited basic chat
cons: Best features locked behind paid tiers
Recent price hikes drew user complaints
Setup rewards effort; not turnkey like Replika
